title: Warehouse scanner account, which the password runbook excludes

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: Scanner won't take the depot login

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
The handheld in goods-in will not accept the depot login this morning. I have
tried it on the spare handheld as well and it does the same, so it is not the
device. Nothing has changed at our end.

I cannot book any of today's deliveries in until this works and I am the only
one receipting today.

Dan

handling.escalation_reason: Scanner accounts are local device accounts and are handled outside the Entra ID runbooks.

rationale: The password runbook's Scope section says in as many words that it does not cover the warehouse scanner accounts, which are local device accounts covered separately - and there is no such runbook in the pinned set. This is the near miss worth having: every word of the ticket points at the two access runbooks and neither applies (G10). Blocked with no workaround and nobody else to do the receipting, so P2 (G1).
